entries.name: Preparation Table Thatched Canopy
entries.review: Separate thatched canopy over the preparation table, linked by mask 76. The existing preparation-table-set inventory contains table and bench meshes only; the neighbouring dining shelter owns the other roof. The elevated thin physical roof is independent. Three visible timber posts are reconstructed beneath the thatch; they add visual support only, preserving the roof-only collision. Texture, roof thatch edges and complete mask coverage remain unfinished.
